newsitem.title: USA: MEMC stock tumbles on profit warning.
newsitem.headline: MEMC stock tumbles on profit warning.

text.p: The stock of MEMC Electronic Materials Inc. tumbled Wednesday in heavy trading, a day after the maker of silicon wafers used in the manufacture of semiconductors, warned of disappointing third-quarter results.
The stock was the day's biggest loser on the New York Stock Exchange, falling $8.50 or more than 29 percent, to $20.75 on volume of more than 3 million shares.
The St. Peters, Mo.-based company said it expected sales for the third quarter ending Sept. 30 to lag that of the second quarter, and end near first-quarter sales of $289.8 million.
"The inventory correction that is taking place in the worldwide semiconductor industry has begun to impact silicon wafer manufacturers," said Ludger H. Viefhues, chief executive officer.

"Although our market ranking and technological leadership put us in a strong competitive position within the industry, we could not maintain our previous growth momentum during these difficult market conditions."
MEMC said it will report final third-quarter results on or about Oct. 24.
